title: Fish rides, bands and dress in the old days
summary: Glass describes dress for fish rides and balls: guinea blue, ruffled dresses, and short pants until 21.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did they have many bands here during that time?
Well, bands like we'd have for fish rides and supper, for the Columnear Hall and things like that. They had bands.

The women used to wear guinea blue dresses and aprils. They were dressed up. When the fella had a pair of overhands and a jumper, you were dressed up. Shoeshine. They had jumpers, shoes, shoeshine, button, jumper with four buttons on each side. The women wear a bonnet with big ruffles on them.
And his watch chains, cross his chest with his father.
Calico. That's right. And we go to Calico Ball? Yeah, they had that. Guinea blue.

Yeah, we had all that. When we come up, we had short pants. I was 21 years old when I was in short pants. The policemen just run us in short pants. We had them big striped stockings. Thick rib stockings.
Thick rib you see. Big black stockings.
We dressed alike. A jumper and our cap. We dressed up. Jeans pants. The women would wear guinea blue dresses. Plenty ruffles around them. Ruffles all around them. Long dresses though.
